cs.m: KBC Poker II with Cherry MX Red
cs.t: I have a Vortex KBC Poker II with PBT keycaps, probably one of the best purchases I've made in recent years. I blew off buying one for a couple of years because it was "just like any other keyboard" - not true. They switches (I have Cherry MX Reds) make it a joy to type on! I should have added that I got mine for about $120, including shipping.
cs.th: Ask HN: What under $100 item would you recommend everyone buy?
